Hostinger migration artifacts for this project

Files Hostinger asked for:
- hostinger-website-files.tar.gz
- hostinger-database.sql

Important notes:
1. The imported database currently uses http://localhost:8080 as home/siteurl because it was exported from the local Docker site.
   After import, update WordPress home/siteurl to your final domain.

2. The website archive now contains a Hostinger-style wp-config.php template at its root.
   If you upload manually, fill in the Hostinger DB name/user/password in public_html/wp-config.php.
   If you use Hostinger's migration team, they may set those values during migration.

Suggested SQL after import:
UPDATE wp_options
SET option_value = 'https://YOUR-DOMAIN'
WHERE option_name IN ('home', 'siteurl');
